documented_probe: C-a3b20c21 (transcribe an algorithm from a photograph of code): covering task. The shipped scenario is a photographic page with a different algorithm shape (guard branch, bitwise ops, modulus fold) than the existing juniper-bridge coverage (photo of a summation loop); the verifier fully re-executes the deliverable on four hidden inputs.
notes: Single-stage but exacting: read a degraded code photograph, transcribe constants/operators/branch polarity exactly, and implement a reusable program that also evaluates a documented auxiliary chain in two variants (guarded vs unguarded). Any single misread character of the photographed routine (multiplier, xor constant, comparison direction, floor-div, modulus) changes truth_id and fails equality. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (multi-op chain + branch), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (4 hidden inputs incl. both branch polarities and a modulus wrap), quantitative_correctness (exact ints), dependent_stages (transcribe-then-implement). No tool breadth, no environment pressure; totals bucket to medium.
